授業概要
総合歯科学および関連領域の最新の知見および研究成果を講義するとともに、専門的文献の抄読や研究成果に関する討議を行う。
This course aims to train experts of general dentistry. Lectures will be given on the latest findings and research results in Interdisciplinary Dentistry, and research meeting will be held to read the research articles and discuss research results.
